race.comment: Looks an open affair to close out the card. WEEKEND SPIRIT (10) has won two of his past three. Was below par two back at this track then bounced back with a win over 1400m at Sunshine Coast last time out. No excuses from an ideal barrier. Can get the job done. GLOBAL ECLIPSE (3) is resuming from a spell. Placed in a recent trial at Doomben to continue his good work in preparation for this. Opened last campaign with a third at Cranbourne over 1600m. Key runner fresh. YABBY PUMP (12) is resuming from a lay-off. Going extra well on the track including a win in his most recent trial at Sunshine Coast. Worth consideration here. BEAT THE RAP (8) has progressed at each appearance, culminating in a win at start three last time out over 1200m at Eagle Farm. Must include.
